findings.text: Each header defines a distinct inclusion guard macro that prevents repeated inclusion during a single translation unit.
Embedded firmware descriptor carries a name reference, a fixed size prefix byte vector, a length value, and a 32 byte digest. Prefix capacity is set by a separate firmware constant.
Slot capacity is 8 entries, per slot resource capacity is 4 entries, device information name capacity is 74 characters, and the absent bus marker is 0.

DMA first status is at 8, interrupt first control at hex 20 with mask at hex 21, interrupt second control at hex A0 with mask at hex A1, DMA second status at hex D0 with single write at hex D4, extended reset at hex 461, edge level controls at hex 4D0 and hex 4D1, vendor identification at hex C80 with configuration at hex C84. Enabled state is 1 and forced state is 2.

Device record combines an identifier, slot and state numbers, base address, a resource array sized by the per slot limit, a DMA mask, an embedded generic device, and an optional printable name when naming is enabled. Driver record pairs an identifier table with an embedded generic driver. Helpers recover the enclosing records from the embedded objects, and region selection masks an address with hex C00.
Driver registration always reports success and unregistration performs no action in this configuration.
Private data retrieval and assignment forward to the generic device private data of the embedded device.

Root record holds a bridge device pointer, a resource pointer, bus base address, slot limit, force probe flag, DMA mask, bus number, and an embedded root resource. Bus number and root resource are assigned when the root is registered.
Largest encodable error magnitude is 4095. Error pointer construction produces a pointer value directly from the numeric error, including the per CPU address space form.

Error decoding returns the pointer bit pattern as a signed value. Error testing reports whether an address lies in the encoded failure range. Per CPU variants apply the same decision after converting the address representation.
Error preserving cast keeps the same bit pattern while removing const qualification. The combined helper yields the decoded error for failure pointers and zero for valid pointers.
Error to name translation always yields a null result in this configuration.

Internal restart and control codes occupy 512 through 519 for restartable system calls, non interruptible and handlerless restarts, missing ioctl command, restart block dispatch, deferred probing, stale open, and unsupported parameter.

Extended file service codes occupy 521 through 531 for bad handle, synchronization mismatch, stale cookie, unsupported operation, undersized buffer, untranslatable server fault, unsupported type, delayed completion, queued completion, recall conflict, and refused lock reclaim.
Membership in the injection list is always negative and type lookup always reports unsupported operation when injection is disabled.

Extended error metadata overlays the socket buffer control area. It contains a header union supporting IPv4 and optionally IPv6, an extended error record, an address offset, a port value, and a flag byte distinguishing statistics collection from reserved bits.
Sequence values for error tracking are 32 bit unsigned quantities.

Ethernet device creation defaults to a single transmit and receive queue, with managed creation using the same single queue default. The multi queue forms forward explicit counts to the shared multi queue allocator.
Reserved base is 01:80:C2:00:00:00 and doubles as the spanning tree address. IPv4 multicast base is 01:00:5E:00:00:00 and IPv6 multicast base is 33:33:00:00:00:00.

Classifiers distinguish link local by masked match against the reserved base, all zero addresses, multicast by the first byte low bit, locally administered by the second bit, broadcast by all ones, unicast as non multicast, and validity as neither multicast nor zero.
A protocol field qualifies as 802.3 length when at or above the 802.3 minimum threshold, ignoring the low order byte on little endian hosts.

Random generation fills six bytes from the random source, clears the multicast bit and sets the local bit. Broadcast generation sets all bytes to ones and zeroing clears all bytes. Random hardware setup additionally records a random assignment type.
Address installation routes through the generic device address modifier, and inheritance first copies the assignment type from the source device before installing its address.
Address integrity value is computed as an Ethernet CRC over the six address bytes.

Copy transfers six address bytes with wide accesses when efficient. Equality reports no differing bits, with 64 bit and unaligned forms adapting to capability. Masked comparison skips bits cleared in the mask. IPv4, IPv6 and combined IP multicast checks apply fixed masks against their respective bases.

Numeric conversion packs address bytes most significant first and unpacks in reverse. Decrement, increment, signed offset addition, and identifier based derivation adjust the packed integer and write the result back as an address.
Address list membership testing acquires read side protection for the duration of the address list walk and releases it before returning the result.
Fourteen byte header comparison yields zero only when destination, source and protocol fields all match, using overlapping wide loads where efficient and narrower loads otherwise.

Receive classification preserves an already matching destination, otherwise assigns broadcast when the destination equals the device broadcast address, multicast when the destination carries the multicast bit, and other host for remaining mismatches.

MAC header location derives from the buffer head plus the stored offset, with an all ones offset meaning unset. Pulling the Ethernet header returns the current data start and advances past the fixed header length, returning null when insufficient data remains.

Minimum size enforcement pads short frames to the Ethernet minimum and signals allocation failure. Linear tail extension advances both tail offset and total length after verifying linearity. Tail address computation has two build dependent forms.
Advancing past the available linear length is fatal and debug builds log diagnostic state before faulting. The linear tail extension path must never be used on nonlinear buffers.
Merge verification allows up to 128 milliseconds and up to 3 retries.

Compatibility flow entry stores type, match and mask unions with extension headers, a ring cookie, and a location. Compatibility control block stores command, type, data, an embedded flow entry, a rule count, and a variable length rule location tail.
Physical identification cycles among inactive, active, on, and off conditions.

Hash function selectors occupy successive bit positions for Toeplitz, exclusive or, and cyclic redundancy variants with a terminal count. Single bit masks identify each function, while unknown and unchanged selectors are both zero.

Ring configuration holds receive buffer size, split and push controls, completion size, push buffer size and limit, and header split threshold with its maximum. Capability flags use bits 0 through 6 to indicate which fields are honored.
External checksum routine relied upon by address integrity computation.
External logging routine relied upon by the buffer handling fault path.
External read side acquisition relied upon by address list scanning.
External read side release relied upon by address list scanning.
